# CMSIS headers used by the optional firmware images

CMSIS 5.0.1 core/compiler headers are used from the installed ARM CMSIS pack.
The relevant ARM headers carry Copyright (c) ARM Limited (individual files
specify years, including 2009-2016 and 2015-2017) and SPDX Apache-2.0 notices.
The Apache License version 2.0 is reproduced in `Apache-2.0.txt`.

The project does not redistribute the full installed CMSIS pack. Original
copyright and license headers remain in the pack files used by the build.
